annotations.title: Check an ad account can run ads

description: Can this ad account run ads right now? Run it BEFORE creating ads, and whenever ads are not delivering. platform meta (default), google_ads or tiktok_ads, plus adAccountId (Meta act_ id, Google customer id, TikTok advertiser id). Meta checks the account status, the payment method, the account spending limit, the Facebook Page and its Instagram account, the Page's Lead Ads terms, the newest pixel event, the WhatsApp number on the Page and rejected ads; Google the account status, billing, the account budget and policy-disapproved ads; TikTok the account status, the balance and rejected ads. Each check is read on its own: one that cannot be read says so (unknown), never 'fine'. Answers ready (false when a new ad would be refused; null when the status itself could not be read), status ok / attention / blocked (blocked also covers what stops delivery but not a create, such as a reached spending limit), and blockers with a plain-words fix and the page to fix it on. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account (act_123), Google Ads customer id, or TikTok advertiser id

loginCustomerId.description: Google: manager account id when acting through one

pageId.description: Meta: the Page the ad will run as (default the ad account’s first Page)
